description:
Fetch and restore a profiling session that react-profiler-stop or native-profiler-stop saved to disk, so the query tools (profiler-cpu-query, profiler-commit-query, profiler-stack-query) can read it.
Use when you need to revisit past session data without capturing a new recording.
Modes:
- list: Show all available profiling sessions in the project's debug directory.
- load_react: Load a React profiler session (CPU profile + commit tree) into memory. Requires session_id.
- load_native: Load a native profiler session (xctrace XML on iOS, .pftrace on Android). Requires session_id.
Loading replaces the session in memory for this device_id (and Metro port, for React): the one the query tools and react-profiler-analyze read. The replaced session stays on disk; load it again by its session_id.
Returns a summary of the loaded session or a session list for the list mode.
Fails if the session_id is not found or the session's trace files are missing from disk.

app_process.description: Android package name to pass when restoring an older load_native .pftrace session that has no metadata sidecar.

device_id.description: Target device id from `list-devices`. Used to cache the loaded React session under the correct port+device key, and required to resolve the native profiler session for load_native.

mode.description: What to do; see Modes in the tool description.

port.description: Metro port. Omit it to use this device's port (8081 by default). Ignored for Chromium, whose CDP port is in device_id. Range: 1 to 65535.

session_id.description: Timestamp-based session identifier (e.g. '20250313-143022') from the list output.

name: profiler-load
